summary: Stays generation halted for 10 days (issue #80): the 2026-08-20 trip-settlement fix wired Life360's is_driving flag through to stay settlement, but the flag is noisy at rest — people sitting at home produce is_driving=True fixes, so a home stay whose tail fix read True was never settled, never closed, and its fixes were watermark-consumed forever. The spatial proxy (dwell past stay_min_dwell_seconds) now wins over the flag for stay settlement, and the watermark holds back an unsettled open stay's fixes until the radius break or the clock closes it. Gridlock false-positives (a real drive stuck in traffic whose tail dwells past the bar) now write one stay instead of none — the accepted trade.
details: tail_dwelled gate extended from is_driving is None to all readings: a tail that has dwelled past min_dwell is a stay-in-progress whatever the flag says
stay-side watermark hold mirrors the existing trip-side hold: an unsettled open stay's fixes stay readable until its fate is decided
sub-min-dwell open stays are not held — they are not stays yet, and holding them would stall the pipeline on noise
limitations: a gridlocked drive whose tail dwells past min_dwell writes one stay (previously zero) — accepted trade for recovering real stays
historical stays lost during the 10-day window are not backfilled; fixes were already watermark-consumed
